reasoning: On the season so far the Trail Blazers are the stronger team; with home court the Trail Blazers start about 15 points better, in a game of about 236 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Pelicans.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Trail Blazers (look-ahead).
Bottom line: the Trail Blazers win 90 times in 100, by about 15; most games like this end between 210 and 258 total points.
